quote: With the advancement of Large Language Modeling (LLM), studies focusing on the application of LLM to code vulnerability detection have started to surface.
outputs: The outputs are vulnerability detection results (classified as vulnerable or not) based on processed PHP code snippets.

quote: In line with the evaluation metrics of existing researches , we employ four metrics: accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score to thoroughly evaluate our experimental results.
